active_findings_without_active_relation.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_findings f WHERE status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM translation_workbench_key_findings r WHERE r.finding_id=f.id AND r.status='active')

active_findings_multiple_active_relation.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT f.id FROM translation_workbench_findings f JOIN translation_workbench_key_findings r ON r.finding_id=f.id AND r.status='active' WHERE f.status='active' GROUP BY f.id HAVING count(*)>1) q

active_relations_to_obsolete_findings.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_key_findings r JOIN translation_workbench_findings f ON f.id=r.finding_id WHERE r.status='active' AND f.status='obsolete'

active_relations_to_obsolete_keys.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_key_findings r JOIN translation_workbench_keys k ON k.id=r.key_id WHERE r.status='active' AND k.status='obsolete'

reviewed_nonobsolete_keys_without_active.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_keys k WHERE k.status<>'obsolete' AND review_status='reviewed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM translation_workbench_key_findings r JOIN translation_workbench_findings f ON f.id=r.finding_id WHERE r.key_id=k.id AND r.status='active' AND f.status='active')

duplicate_nonobsolete_translation_keys.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT translation_key FROM translation_workbench_keys WHERE status<>'obsolete' AND nullif(translation_key,'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY translation_key HAVING count(*)>1) q

duplicate_nonobsolete_reviewed_keys.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT translation_key FROM translation_workbench_keys WHERE status<>'obsolete' AND review_status='reviewed' AND nullif(translation_key,'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY translation_key HAVING count(*)>1) q

duplicate_lang_locale_namespace_key.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT locale,namespace,lang_key FROM translation_workbench_lang_values GROUP BY locale,namespace,lang_key HAVING count(*)>1) q

active_values_without_nonobsolete_key.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_lang_values v WHERE status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM translation_workbench_keys k WHERE k.translation_key=v.translation_key AND k.status<>'obsolete')

active_values_without_reviewed_key.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_workbench_lang_values v WHERE status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM translation_workbench_keys k WHERE k.translation_key=v.translation_key AND k.status<>'obsolete' AND k.review_status='reviewed')

active_key_findings_owner_differs_from_c.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT f.id) FROM translation_workbench_findings f JOIN translation_workbench_key_findings r ON r.finding_id=f.id AND r.status='active' JOIN translation_workbench_keys k ON k.id=r.key_id AND k.status<>'obsolete' WHERE f.status='active' AND nullif(f.found_translation_key,'') IS NOT NULL AND nullif(k.translation_key,'') IS NOT NULL AND f.found_translation_key<>k.translation_key

legacy_workbench_common_values.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_values v JOIN translation_keys k ON k.id=v.translation_key_id JOIN translation_workbench_lang_values w ON w.translation_key=k.key AND w.locale=v.locale WHERE w.status='active'

legacy_workbench_different_common_values.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM translation_values v JOIN translation_keys k ON k.id=v.translation_key_id JOIN translation_workbench_lang_values w ON w.translation_key=k.key AND w.locale=v.locale WHERE w.status='active' AND w.value IS DISTINCT FROM v.value
